rationale: With only 2 minutes until market close, any position opened now would be liquidated at the market within seconds, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially given XPO's wide intraday range today ($169.11–$190.98) and 13.7 bps spread. The risk/reward of entering a position with such a compressed time horizon and forced market-close liquidation does not justify the trade regardless of directional signal.
